invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.16.0 preserves Parts 1–14 and completes Part 15 Tax Engine while owning a dedicated responsive module shell. Desktop Invoicing uses a fixed full-height 286px sidebar with the work area beside it; mobile uses a drawer. Create Invoice, New Customer, New Item and Receive Payment are focused routes rather than stacked above their registers. Production Invoicing schema releases follow expand-before-promote migration ordering so users are not blocked by version drift. Future changes must keep Invoicing, app-surface, ERP integration, platform closure, core-hardening, TypeScript, migration dry-run and production deployment gates green.
